Install omarchy-dev on Omarchy

This is the same Omarchy Linux distribution by DHH, but built from the tip of its in-development 'quattro' branch rather than a stable release. It carries the same curated Hyprland desktop, terminal, editor, and agent tooling as the main omarchy package, just with the newest, potentially unstable changes applied first. It's meant for people who want to track Omarchy's development in real time rather than wait for tagged releases.

Watch: Omarchy Quattro Linux Review ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-dev
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 4.0.0.r1832.g23dab9e-1:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-dev

Open and use omarchy-dev

omarchy-dev is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql omarchy-dev | grep applications

omarchy-dev requirements and compatibility

  • A machine (or VM) that can run Arch Linux
  • Tolerance for in-development, potentially unstable changes

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-dev on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-dev. The download is 66 MB and it takes 69.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-dev free?

Free and open source (MIT licensed, free ISO/package). The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omarchy-dev?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-dev. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-dev depend on?

The package declares 21 dependencies: omarchy-keyring, omarchy-settings-dev, limine, limine-mkinitcpio-hook, limine-snapper-sync, snapper, hyprland, quickshell, uwsm, sddm, xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland, wireplumber and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omarchy-dev a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for omarchy-dev.

Is omarchy-dev in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-dev (version 4.0.0.r1832.g23dab9e-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. 37signals makes it. Project site: https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy.
